detail.longDescription: Five ways to get weather while you work: search query, weather website, desktop widget, browser extension, or weather API. Each has different tradeoffs for intent, privacy, and integration. If you open many new tabs during your work day, the extension approach wins because you see the forecast without any extra action: https:// dev.to/weatherclockdash/weathe r-in-your-browser-5-options-compared-search-app-widget-extension-api-2f7l # Productivity # Weather # Firefox
